title: Agent operator contract ManifestEntry
description: One file in an attempt manifest (spec section 7.6): relative POSIX path, exact kind enum, media type, size and sha256, plus the optional 1.2 fields that link tool calls, results and model outputs.

path.description: Relative POSIX path: no leading slash, no '..' segment.

at.description: Since 1.2: when the engine wrote the artifact.

call_id.description: Since 1.2: opaque; the same on a tool call and its result, unique per kind in the Attempt.

tool.description: Since 1.2: the tool's name as the engine calls it.

origin.description: Since 1.2: a Usage Origin name (spec section 7.2), an open set.

conversation.description: Since 1.2: opaque label grouping the artifacts of one model conversation.
